text:
maya: Heads up — EU aggregates for `session_active_mins` are ~12h stale for multiple customers. Seen in dashboards and raw telemetry. Thinking a targeted refresh for 2026-03-19 00:00 → 2026-03-20 12:00 (hot window). Can we coordinate operator handoff + quota bump?

thomas: I can kick off the replayer but the low-priority lane is saturated. We could move this to a temporary priority lane for EU shards 12-18. Need a quota increase and a short maintenance window.

arjun: Cost heads-up: S3 IO + parquet scans will spike. Recommend running with a dedupe filter and a shard-level watermark to avoid reprocessing duplicates. Also run a dry-run first: `--dry-run --limit 1000` to sanity check.

sasha: Prefer we use the new Console "Targeted Refresh" flow so PMs/CS can watch progress. I can enable the canary for the EU tenant group. @olivia do you want this visible to anyone outside eng?

olivia: :eyes: Keep it internal for the first run. Product asks for per-customer progress and a fallback routing note in case aggregates fail (so UI can show degraded but usable view). Need ETA + rollback signal in Console.

liu: On-call note: make sure KV-cache rehydrate is sequenced after compute finishes so queries don't hit stale caches. Add a short shard lock to prevent parallel runs. Example lock step: `psql -c "SELECT take_lock('recompute', shard);"` and release after rehydrate. Also add alert if replayer takes >4h for a shard.

ops-bot: ALERT: Replayer queue length > 1000 in eu-west-1 — auto-throttle enabled.

thomas: Ack auto-throttle. I'll open a quota request: `/infra quota-request replayer eu-west-1 +3` and then start workers with `--shards 12-18 --dedupe true --dry-run false`. Will monitor cost.

arjun: I'll prepare the dedupe filter and a small schema validation step to drop late duplicates. Will also export a sample of 5k rows for quick verification.

sasha: I'll flip the canary on the Console at start time and add the rollback button (hide it behind internal flag). Also will add per-tenant progress bar and links to the replayer logs.

maya: Plan summary: thomas runs replayer, arjun provides dedupe + dry-run, liu adds lock + post-recompute KV rehydrate hook, sasha enables console canary, olivia will verify product checks. Target start: 23:00 UTC tonight.

thomas: Got it, scheduling and will post start/finish timestamps here.

arjun: Will push dedupe branch and ping when ready for dry-run.

liu: I'll add the lock and alerting rule, will validate on staging first.

sasha: Canary ready on my side.

maya: Thanks team — marking owners and moving to handoff. :thumbsup:
